_comment: Single source of truth for dashboard text/value readout placement and editor-adjustable structural items. Consumed directly by tools/layout_editor.html, and converted for firmware into include/cyd_layout_generated.h by tools/generate_layout_header.py. Coordinates are 320x240 device pixels. anchor: la=top-left, mm=center, ra=right. fit=[fonts] picks the first font whose rendered width fits max_w (mirrors firmware drawCenteredFittedText). 'label'/'extras' are sub-texts drawn at dx/dy relative to the element. Screens use ordered items with kind=text/shape. Screens marked readOnly (11 Gauge, 12 Efficiency) are drawn in dashboards.cpp and are listed only so the editor shows every theme; they have no items and generate no constants.
